summary.text: Joe Aragona is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 60 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Joe Aragona's general-election opponent is Amy Gray (D).
He chairs the House Regulatory Reform Committee and previously served as deputy supervisor of Harrison Township.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Aragona graduated from Lutheran High School North in 2006, earned a B.S. in biomedical diagnostics from Oakland University in 2011, and holds an executive M.B.A. from Michigan State University.
He served as deputy supervisor of Harrison Township and has been affiliated with the Humane Society of Macomb, Clinton Township Goodfellows, and the Clinton Township Kiwanis Club.
Aragona assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023.
In 2025-2026 he chairs the House Regulatory Reform Committee, is Majority Vice Chair of the Rules and Competitiveness Committee, and also serves on the Financial Services and Insurance committees.
